# Bitcoin Friesland

> Bitcoin Friesland (Frysk: Bitcoin Fryslân) is a volunteer community for Bitcoin education, adoption and meetups in the Dutch province of Friesland. Participation in the community and its Telegram and Signal groups is free. The site is informational and does not provide financial advice.

The site is available in Dutch (`nl`), English (`en`) and Frisian (`fy`). Dutch is the default language.

The linked HTML pages are the primary source; Markdown counterparts are summaries. For changing event details and business payment options, check the organizer or business linked from the relevant page. Community contributors maintain this website; corrections can be sent to info@bitcoinfriesland.com with the page URL and a supporting source. A listing is not an endorsement.

Important facts:

- Individual supporter contribution: the current satoshi value of EUR 21 for one year, paid in sats only.
- Supporter benefits: 21 Bitcoin Friesland stickers, event discount codes and a supporter tag in Telegram and Signal.
- The supporter form is a request; it does not take payment or activate supportership automatically.
- Financial or material support never buys influence, exclusivity, editorial control or an endorsement.

## Dutch core pages

- [Home](https://bitcoinfriesland.com/nl/index.html.md): Community overview and main routes into the site.
- [Meetups and events](https://bitcoinfriesland.com/nl/meetings.html.md): Upcoming and past events, including current ticket information.
- [Bitcoin map](https://bitcoinfriesland.com/nl/map.html.md): How to find places that accept Bitcoin in Friesland.
- [Supporter programme](https://bitcoinfriesland.com/nl/support.html.md): Contribution, benefits, payment and sticker-delivery details.

## Frisian core pages

- [Thusside](https://bitcoinfriesland.com/fy/index.html.md): Frysk oersjoch fan de mienskip en de wichtichste siden.
- [Gearkomsten en eveneminten](https://bitcoinfriesland.com/fy/meetings.html.md): Takomstige en ôfrune eveneminten mei aktuele ticketynformaasje.
- [Bitcoinkaart](https://bitcoinfriesland.com/fy/map.html.md): Plakken fine dêr'tst yn Fryslân mei Bitcoin betelje kinst.
- [Stiperprogramma](https://bitcoinfriesland.com/fy/support.html.md): Bydrage, foardielen, betelling en ferstjoeren of opheljen fan stickers.

## News and feeds

- [Dutch Bitcoin Friesland news](https://bitcoinfriesland.com/nl/blog/): Guides, news and community stories.
- [Dutch RSS feed](https://bitcoinfriesland.com/nl/blog/rss.xml): Machine-readable feed for new articles.
- [Getting started with Bitcoin in Friesland](https://bitcoinfriesland.com/nl/blog/beginnen-met-bitcoin-in-friesland.html): Practical Dutch beginner guide.
